Speech recognition model — attribution
======================================

Reed downloads a speech-recognition model onto your Mac after installation.
The model is not part of this application bundle and is not distributed with
it; this notice records what the model is and the terms it carries.

Model as downloaded
-------------------
  FluidInference/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-coreml
  https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-coreml

  A Core ML conversion, by FluidInference, of the base model below. In the
  words of its own model card: "On-device multilingual ASR model converted to
  Core ML for Apple platforms." The conversion script the card points to is
  https://github.com/FluidInference/mobius/tree/main/models/stt/parakeet-tdt-v3-0.6b/coreml

Base model
----------
  nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
  https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3

  Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The NVIDIA model card states:
  "GOVERNING TERMS: Use of this model is governed by the CC-BY-4.0 license."
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.en

Licence of the converted model — unresolved
-------------------------------------------
The conversion repository states two different things, and this notice does
not choose between them:

  * its model-card metadata declares    license: cc-by-4.0
  * its prose "## License" section says "Apache 2.0. See the FluidAudio
    repository for details and usage guidance."

The base model's terms are unambiguously CC-BY-4.0. Reed makes no election
between the two statements above; the discrepancy is recorded as an open
question for the model's publisher and for Reed's owner, and this file will be
corrected once it is settled. FluidAudio's own source code is Apache-2.0, but
a library's code licence does not determine the terms of model weights it
downloads.

Changes made by Reed
--------------------
None. Reed downloads the converted model as published and does not modify,
retrain or redistribute it. The conversion from the NVIDIA base model to Core
ML was performed upstream by FluidInference, not by Reed.

Which bytes you receive
-----------------------
Reed's model downloader requests the repository's `main` branch and does not
pin a revision, so the exact files a given install receives are whatever that
repository serves at download time. For reference only, the repository was at
revision 7dd20fe6b1797d35f5e3307e8b1732d9a178edfe when this notice was
written. That is a record of what was observed, not a pin, and it does not
constrain what a later download returns.

Sources recorded: docs/steps/oss-05-verification.md and
legal/third-party/PROVENANCE.md
